loginSecurity.title: Login & Security
loginSecurity.description: Update your password, manage security preferences, and review active sessions.

password.title: Password
password.descriptionLocal: Choose a strong password you do not use elsewhere.
password.descriptionSocial: Your account uses social sign-in. Manage your password with your provider.
password.socialNote: Signed in with {{provider}}. Password changes are managed by your identity provider, not CareerBridge.

twoFactor.title: Two-Factor Authentication
twoFactor.description: Require an authenticator app code when signing in on untrusted devices.

securityPrefs.title: Security Preferences
securityPrefs.loginAlertsDescription: Get notified when someone signs in from an unfamiliar device or IP address.
securityPrefs.rememberDevicesDescription: Mark trusted devices to skip login alert emails on familiar browsers.

sessions.title: Active Sessions
sessions.description: Devices currently signed in to your account.
sessions.passwordNote: Changing your password clears device trust and signs out other browsers using your account.
sessions.loadError: Unable to load active sessions right now. Please refresh the page and try again.
sessions.empty: No active sessions were found. Sign in again to refresh this list.

toasts.passwordSocialOnly: Password changes are only available for email and password accounts.
toasts.passwordFieldsRequired: Please fill in all password fields.
toasts.passwordMismatch: New password and confirmation do not match.
toasts.passwordChangeError: Unable to change password. Please try again.
toasts.signOutDeviceError: Unable to sign out that device.
toasts.noOtherSessions: No other active sessions to sign out.
toasts.othersSignedOut: Other devices have been signed out.
toasts.signOutOthersError: Unable to sign out other devices.
toasts.trustRememberRequired: Enable Remember Devices before trusting a device.

appearance.title: Appearance & Language
appearance.description: Customize how CareerBridge looks and displays information.

account.title: Account Management
account.description: Manage account status, data export, and sign out options.

export.title: Export Data
export.description: Download a copy of your profile, resumes, and account activity.
export.archiveDescription: Receive a ZIP file with your profile, resumes, and sanitized session history. Limited to one export every 24 hours.
export.dialogDescription: We will prepare a ZIP file with your profile, resumes, and sanitized session history. Excludes passwords and security secrets. You can request another export after 24 hours.

deactivate.title: Deactivate Account
deactivate.description: Temporarily disable your account. Your data will be preserved and you can reactivate anytime.
deactivate.pauseDescription: You will be signed out on all devices. To sign in again, you must explicitly confirm reactivation — we will not restore access automatically.
deactivate.dialogDescription: You will be signed out everywhere. Your data stays saved, but signing in again will require an explicit reactivation confirmation.
deactivate.successDescription: Your account has been paused. Sign in anytime and confirm reactivation to restore access.

signOut.title: Sign Out
signOut.description: Sign out of your account on this device. Your session will end here and on the server.
signOut.dialogDescription: You will need to sign in again to access your account on this device.

delete.title: Delete Account
delete.description: Permanently remove your account and all associated data.
delete.permanentDescription: All resumes, preferences, sessions, and account history for {{email}} will be deleted and cannot be recovered.
delete.acknowledge: I understand this action cannot be undone and all my data will be permanently deleted.
delete.phraseHint: Type {{phrase}} exactly. For security, you must have signed in recently with your provider.
delete.requirementsMet: Requirements met. You can delete your account.
delete.requirementsPending: Complete all requirements above to enable deletion.
delete.successDescription: Your account and associated data have been permanently removed. Redirecting you now…

errors.acknowledge: Please confirm that you understand this action cannot be undone.
errors.password: Enter your password to confirm account deletion.
errors.email: Email must match your account email exactly.

twoFactor.recoveryMessage: If you lose your authenticator and all backup codes, contact support from your registered email so we can verify your identity and manually disable two-factor authentication on your account.
twoFactor.backupCodesDescription: Each code works once. Store them somewhere safe — they will not be shown again.
twoFactor.enabled: Two-factor authentication is enabled on your account.
twoFactor.scanQr: Scan the QR code or enter the key in Google Authenticator, Authy, or a compatible app.

toasts.setupStarted: Scan the QR code with your authenticator app.
toasts.invalidCode: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
toasts.disableCodeRequired: Enter your authenticator code to disable 2FA.
toasts.regenPasswordRequired: Enter your password to regenerate backup codes.
